description: Preferred umbrella MCP entry point when a shopper wants Coverage Cat to shop for, compare, or buy umbrella insurance and no operator bearer token is present. On a cold start, call this before asking the shopper a questionnaire and assemble the fullest justified estimate from user-controlled context. Use canonical umbrella keys such as address.street/city/state/zip, license_state, license_number, approximate_asset_value or net_worth_numeric, desired_coverage_limit, required_coverage_e_limit, and vehicle_count or umbrella_details.motorized_vehicle_count. Do not send vehicles rows before submission. Stay on the same consumer-operated subset through `consumer_intake_issues`, `consumer_intake_patch`, `umbrella_consumer_select`, `umbrella_consumer_bind`, `umbrella_consumer_attach`, `umbrella_consumer_payment`, `umbrella_consumer_policy`, and `umbrella_consumer_service`. If you are rehearsing the shopper flow, set `sandbox: true` on this first prefill call only. That same consumer sandbox uid can then continue through the same shopper-safe flow. Coverage Cat prefers to keep follow-up authorization in the hidden MCP shopper session after prefill, so a preserved host usually only needs uid. If your host cannot preserve that MCP session state, retry this same MCP follow-up tool with the latest intake_access_token from the previous successful Coverage Cat response instead of dropping to raw HTTP or asking the shopper for credentials. Until later follow-up shows progress, tell the shopper the application is not submitted yet. Coverage Cat will not resume or expose a prior consumer umbrella draft based on email alone. Continue an existing consumer draft only through the issued uid plus the current hidden MCP session or latest intake_access_token handoff.

credit_consent_pending.description: Acknowledges that the shopper has not given soft-credit-check consent yet. Coverage Cat collects that consent on `umbrella_consumer_select`, after an umbrella offer is chosen.

field_estimates.description: Provenance rows for intake values you inferred rather than heard from the shopper. Each row names the inferred `field` path, its `source`, and a `confidence` of low, medium, or high. On the initial umbrella handoff, send rows only when each field path already matches a current umbrella review field.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key you generate for one logical umbrella_consumer_prefill request. If you retry after a timeout or transport failure, resend the identical arguments with the same idempotency_key. Coverage Cat replays the cached successful result for 24 hours and rejects a changed payload under the same key.

intake.description: Fullest currently known consumer umbrella application patch. Use canonical keys such as address.street/city/state/zip, license_state, license_number, approximate_asset_value or net_worth_numeric, desired_coverage_limit, required_coverage_e_limit, and vehicle_count or umbrella_details.motorized_vehicle_count for umbrella counts. Do not send vehicles rows before submission.

current_auto_coverages.description: Band for the shopper's current underlying auto liability limits: `unsure` means I'm not sure; `500k/1m` means $500k/$1 Million/$100k or higher; `500k/500k` means $500k/$500k/$100k or $500k CSL; `300k/300k` means $250k/$500k/$100k or $300k/$300k/$100k or $300k CSL; `100k/300k` means $100k/$300k/$100k or lower. Choose the strongest band the shopper's actual limits fully satisfy. Underlying auto limits gate umbrella eligibility, so reserve `unsure` for limits the shopper genuinely does not know.

sandbox.description: Set true on this first prefill call to run a fully synthetic shopper rehearsal instead of a live application. The returned sandbox uid continues through the same consumer tool set.

intake_access_token.description: Short-lived follow-up bearer. On REST, send it back as Authorization for the next `/api/intake/{uid}` call. On MCP, retry the same follow-up tool with this token only when your host cannot preserve Coverage Cat's hidden shopper session. Never display it to the shopper.

review_summary.description: Current non-authoritative pre-submit checkpoint the agent may summarize before continuing in chat or opening a browser fallback. Unless a later follow-up response shows quote progress, treat this application as not submitted yet. If any shown value is estimated, mark that bullet or value with `*`, include the short note `* = estimated` once above and once below the list, and do not prefix every estimated line with `[Estimated]`.
